verdict.rationale: Codegen generates AI insights and suggestions on development data. Its agent reviews PRs and suggests changes (codegen-docs-4), summarizes diffs and checks coverage (codegen-docs-20), and analyzes sandbox setup logs to explain what went wrong and suggest fixes (codegen-docs-39). These insights are scoped to code, PRs and logs, are delivered mainly through agent runs and API endpoints, and come only from vendor docs. missing for 10: broader insights across the user's own data beyond code and logs, an in-product insights or suggestions surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
